ayahOccurrences.text: فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُۥ كَيْفَ يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْغُرَابِ فَأُوَٰرِىَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِى ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰدِمِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: أَعَجَزْتُ is in the derivative form: عَجَزَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ج/ز   ʿ–j–z posteriors, buttocks, (of palm trees) stumps
; to hang back, to fail to perform, lack of strength, lack of ability, failure, to grow old; miracle, to out‐perform.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 26 times in the Qur’an:
عَجَزَ ʿajaza 1 time; أعْجَزَ ʾaʿjaza 4 times; عَجُوزٌ ʿajūz 4 times; أَعْجَازٌ ʾaʿjāz 2 times; مُعَاجِزِين muʿājizın 3 times;مُعْجِزٌ muʿjiz 1 time and مُعْجِزِين muʿjizın 11 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَجَزَ ʿajaza i (also عَجِز ʿajiza a) [v. intrans.] to fail to act, to be or become incapable of, to become powerless, impotent or unable to carry out something, to weaken

(5:31)‏أَعَجَزْتُ‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏أَكُونَ‏ ‏مِثْلَ‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏الْغُرَابِ‏ ‏فَأُوَارِيَ‏ ‏سَوْأَةَ‏ ‏أَخِي‏ am I not [even] able to be like this raven and cover up my brother’s exposed body?

عَجَزَ ʿajaza i (also عَجِز ʿajiza a) [v. intrans.] to fail to act, to be or become incapable of, to become powerless, impotent or unable to carry out something, to weaken

(5:31)‏أَعَجَزْتُ‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏أَكُونَ‏ ‏مِثْلَ‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏الْغُرَابِ‏ ‏فَأُوَارِيَ‏ ‏سَوْأَةَ‏ ‏أَخِي‏ am I not [even] able to be like this raven and cover up my brother’s exposed body?

entries.label: أَعْجَازٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَعْجَازٌ ʾaʿjāz [pl. of n. عَجُزٌ ʿajuz] stems, stumps, trunks (of palm trees)

(69:7) ‏فَتَرَى‏ ‏الْقَوْمَ‏ ‏فِيهَا‏ ‏صَرْعَى‏ ‏كَأَنَّهُمْ‏ ‏أَعْجَازُ‏ ‏نَخْلٍ‏ ‏خَاوِيَةٍ‏ so you could have seen the people lying dead as if they were hollow palmtree trunks.

entries.label: أَعْجَزَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَعْجَزَ ʾaʿjaza [v. IV trans.]

1 to prove incapable of, to outsrip someone, to frustrate someone

(72:12) وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِى الأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا and we came to know that we can never outstrip God on earth and can never escape beyond His reach

2 to fall outside the capability of, to out‐class someone

(35:44) ‏وَمَا‏ ‏كَانَ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏لِيُعْجِزَهُ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏شَيْءٍ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏السَّمَوَاتِ‏ ‏وَلاَ‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏الأَرْضِ God is not such that anything in the heavens or on earth is beyond Him.‏

entries.label: عَجُوزٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَجُوزٌ ʿajūz [quasi‐act. part., fem. of شَيْخ shaykh] very old woman

(11:72) ‏ءَأَلِدُ‏ ‏وَأَنَا‏ ‏عَجُوزٌ‏ ‏وَهَذَا‏ ‏بَعْلِي‏ ‏شَيْخًا‏ am I to bear [a child] when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man?

entries.label: مُعَاجِزِين
entries.definitionHtml:
مُعَاجِزِين muʿājizın [pl. of act. part. مُعَاجِز muʿājiz of v. III] one who fights and contests with another in order to prove him less capable or incapable altogether, contentious

(22:51) وَالَّذِينَ‏ ‏سَعَوْا‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏ءَايَاتِنَا‏ ‏مُعَاجِزِينَ but those who strive to oppose Our messages and act contentiously.

entries.label: مُعْجِزٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُعْجِزٌ muʿjiz [act. part., pl. مُعْجِزِين muʿjizın]

1 one who proves others to be weak or incapable, one who outdoes someone else

(9:3) ‏وَإِنْ‏ ‏تَوَلَّيْتُمْ‏ ‏فَاعْلَمُوا‏ ‏أَنَّكُمْ‏ ‏غَيْرُ‏ ‏مُعْجِزِي‏ ‏اللَّهِ‏‏ if you turn away, know that you cannot outdo God

2 one who is beyond reach

(11:33) قَالَ‏ ‏إِنَّمَا‏ ‏يَأْتِيكُمْ‏ ‏بِهِ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏إِنْ‏ ‏شَاءَ‏ ‏وَمَا‏ ‏أَنْتُمْ‏ ‏بِمُعْجِزِينَ‏ he said, ‘It is God who will bring it upon you, if He wishes, and you are not beyond reach.’
